high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website timesnownews.com. The article is titled "Gabriel García Márquez Was a Struggling Journalist in Mexico City." The content of the article discusses Gabriel García Márquez's early struggles as a journalist in Mexico City before he became known for his magical realism literature. The text describes how Márquez faced numerous rejections and lived in a state of humiliation and self-doubt, which ultimately led him to withdraw from society and focus intensely on writing.
